Pune Realtor's Death Investigated as Murder Plot Involving Fiancée

Authorities are investigating the death of Pune realtor Ketan Agarwal, initially believed to be an accident at Lohagad Fort, as a suspected murder plot. The investigation reportedly involves his fiancée, Siya Goyal, and her partner, Chetan Chaudhary. Police are examining digital evidence, timelines, and witness statements to reconstruct the alleged conspiracy.
